## 3. Major Financial AI Company News

**2026-06-25 — General Intuition raises $320M**
[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/general-intuitions-2-3b-bet-that-video-games-can-train-ai-agents-for-the-real-world/) reported General Intuition raised $320M at a $2.3B valuation, led by Khosla Ventures. The company uses action-labeled gameplay data to train spatial-temporal agents and world models.

**Why it matters:** Capital is still flowing into agent/world-model infrastructure outside the foundation-model majors, especially where training data can be generated or structured at scale.

**2026-06-25 — Adobe acquiring Topaz Labs**
[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/adobe-acquires-image-and-video-enhancement-tool-maker-topaz-labs/) reported Adobe is acquiring Topaz Labs, maker of AI image and video enhancement tools. Adobe plans to integrate Topaz models into Firefly and Creative Cloud while keeping Topaz products available standalone.

**Why it matters:** Adobe is consolidating specialist creative-AI tooling into its core suite, strengthening the enhancement/upscaling layer rather than only text-to-image generation.
